note: Per-route ceilings on inline <script is:inline> bytes, enforced by frontend/tests/jsbudget.test.ts in `make test-web` (ADR-0021, ported from the US Code site's ADR-0046). Raising a ceiling is a decision: do it in the same commit as the growth and say why in BUILDLOG.md.
counted: Bytes inside <script is:inline> across each route's transitive .astro import graph. Where two page files serve one route, the ceiling is the heavier of the two, since a request reaches one and never both. Comments inside those scripts are counted, because Astro ships inline scripts verbatim and a reader downloads them.
headroom: Each ceiling is the measured size plus 200 bytes, rounded up to the next 500, so an ordinary comment edit does not fail the build but real growth does.
